description_en: Calls DescribeUserInfoInChannel to query the real-time information of a user in a channel
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserInfoInChannel查询用户在频道中实时信息
name: DescribeUserInfoInChannel

parameters.help_en: The application ID, which is created and queried through the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: user_id

IsChannelExist.description_en:
Indicates whether the channel exists. Valid values:
true: The channel exists.
false: The channel does not exist
IsChannelExist.description_zh:
频道是否存在，取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

IsInChannel.description_en:
Indicates whether the user is currently in the channel. Valid values:
true: The user is in the channel.
false: The user is not in the channel
IsInChannel.description_zh:
用户当前是否在频道内，取值：
true：在频道内。
false：不在频道内

Property.description_en: The information of the user in the channel

items.description_en: The information of the user in the channel

Join.description_en: The time when the user joined the meeting (UTC time)
Join.description_zh: 用户进入会议的时间（UTC时间）

Role.description_en:
The role type in the meeting. Valid values:

0: The user role in communication mode.
 
1: The interactive role.
 
2: The live (view only) role
Role.description_zh:
会议中的角色类型，取值：

0：通信模式下的用户角色。
 
1：interactive（参与互动）角色。
 
2：live（仅观看）角色

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the current moment (UTC time)
Timestamp.description_zh: 当前时刻的时间戳（UTC时间）
